rows.abstract: Seeks to protect, promote and improve the social and economic status of day care workers by providing for their: a) salary; b) working hours; c) additional compensation and allowance; d) transfer and tenure; e) leave credit benefits; f) medical, insurance and retirement benefits; g) freedom to organize; and h) code of conduct.
rows.status: Referred to Stakeholders on 2009-08-13

rows.abstract: The bill seeks to increase the monthly honoraria or allwances granted to barangay officials to P2,500 for the punong barangay; P1,800 for sangguniang barangay members and P1,500 for the barangay treasurer, secretary and tanods.

rows.author: E015
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING INCENTIVES AND BENEFITS TO RURAL HEALTH UNIT DOCTORS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Rural Health Unit Doctors Benefits and Incentives Act of 2004\"
rows.abstract: \"Rural Health Unit Doctors Benefits and Incentives Act of 2004\".  In addition to incentives and benefits granted under existing laws, the bill seeks to grant rural health doctors the following: a) hazard allowance; b) subsistence allowance; c) scholarship up to the third legitimate child; d) income tax exemption; e) automatic promotion to the next higher position; f) free legal representation; and g) zero interest on policy, salary and housing loans from the GSIS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2007-08-13
